canonicalAnalysisManifest.description: Current 33-key CAN_* registry for understood Driver Quality, Vehicle Load, Brake Physics, Tire Dynamic Load and context. NOT the complete provider-observation universe.

ICE_DIESEL.notes: DEF level operational field outside 33-key set

canonicalAnalysisManifest.note: CAN-33 prioritization for analysis alignment; does NOT limit Phase 3A reference capture breadth.

broadReferenceObservationManifest.description: Phase 3A research capture surface: all empirically/capability-discovered provider telemetry signals retrievable for the concrete vehicle/session on DIMO_LTE_R1.
hierarchy: raw provider namespace DIMO::<field> where unmapped

broadReferenceObservationPolicy.rule: For each reference vehicle/session, capture EVERY provider telemetry signal that is capability-discovered or empirically observed as available where DIMO acquisition surface permits retrieval.

controlledDirectProbeMechanism.purpose: Probe schema-supported fields not listed in availableSignals once/diagnostically when scientifically high-value

temporalAcquisitionClasses.principle: Broad observation breadth is independent of acquisition cadence. Retain all available signals; assign temporal class per signal.

knownAnalysisEventSet.description: Minimum known behavioral filters aligned with current Q015 scoring surface

broadProviderEventObservationSet.rule: Retain ALL provider events actually returned for reference vehicle/session when event API permits — do not drop unknown event names

segmentObservationPolicy.rule: If segment mechanism can be safely queried/captured for vehicle/session, retain results for research/validation even if no current score consumes them

analysisEligibilityVsReferenceCaptureEli.analysisEligibility: Whether signal/event participates in current Driver Quality, Vehicle Load, Brake Physics, Tire Dynamic Load scoring/detector design
analysisEligibilityVsReferenceCaptureEli.referenceCaptureEligibility: Whether signal/event MUST be retained in Phase 3A broad reference capture when vehicle/provider permits retrieval
rules: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY describes current analysis use — NOT do-not-observe in reference mode
CONTEXT_ONLY fields remain reference-capturable at appropriate temporal class
CAN_* mapped signals follow canonical analysis contract PLUS broad capture when available

powertrainOverlayPolicy.example: Do not query BEV-only fields on ICE once capability confirms absence; retain all other available ICE/provider fields in broad capture

designPrinciples.meaning: Maximize information coverage of the vehicle-supported provider surface — not query count or uniform polling frequency
designPrinciples.supersedes: Scientific sufficiency, not query maximalism (misread as narrow capture)

phase3AGate.referenceDriveBlockedBy: PRE_RECORDER_BLOCKER probes resolved during Phase 3A implementation/preflight (RP-010, RP-039, RP-040, RP-044, RP-045)
